Thanks — Tue 24 Aug 14:00 PT works for Orchid. Iʼve attached our canonical CAIQ (orchid_caiq_v3.xlsx) and a short note about required evidence for a few high‑priority controls. A couple of clarifications ahead of the call:

- KMS: weʼd like an overview of key lifecycle (creation/rotation/revocation) and any HSM/KMS provider names for our internal risk inventory.
- Incident response: if you can point to a redacted post‑mortem example (timeline + remediation) thatʼd be helpful — redaction for customer names is fine.

Weʼll be on the call: Emma (security PM), Rajiv (security lead), and Ali Khan (platform engineer). Looking forward to the draft artifacts.

—Rajiv
Director, Security Architecture
Orchid Labs
